name: VideoAutoArena
description: VideoAutoArena is an automated arena-style benchmark for evaluating large multimodal models in video analysis using user simulation to generate open-ended, adaptive questions. It incorporates a scalable evaluation framework with a modified ELO rating system and includes VideoAutoBench as an auxiliary benchmark with human-validated annotations.
reputation: A recent research benchmark from the VideoAutoArena paper, but it is not yet widely established as a standard community leaderboard.
notes: Automated, scalable evaluation with user simulation and fault-driven evolution strategy; validated against human annotations.
